_note: Sitting Tennessee, Indiana and Missouri state legislators, read from official legislative sources on 2026-10-24. cmp-data.js carries a roster shell for every "rows" entry; "districtSet" names existing records that gained their district; "onFileAsCandidate" seats are left empty because the member is held only as a 2026 candidate row under another office; "nameSharedWithAnotherRecord" seats are left empty because another record carries the same display name. Tennessee and Missouri were read from each chamber's own member directory (Missouri's House from its per-district member files, which mark a vacant seat <VacantName>Vacant</VacantName>). The Indiana General Assembly's member data was not reachable from this environment, so Indiana was read from the four legislative caucuses' own member lists (Senate and House, Republican and Democratic); a member was kept only where those lists together name exactly one member for the seat, and every Indiana Senate seat and 98 of 100 House seats are named exactly once. Tennessee Senate 31's Brent Taylor, House 45's Johnny Garrett, House 86's Justin J. Pearson, Missouri Senate 31's Rick Brattin and Indiana Senate 29's J.D. Ford are held only as 2026 candidate rows. Missouri House 30's Jonathan Patterson is the Speaker, filed as jon_patterson.

statehouse: https://www.indianahouserepublicans.com/members (and each member's page for the district)

Indiana.why: Neither House caucus lists a member for these two districts (the Republican caucus states 70 members and lists 68), so their current holders could not be verified and the seats are left empty.
